content: Customer Aditi Mahajan expressed disappointment that her health policy expired due to missed premiums. Agent Ramesh Tiwari explained that obtaining a new policy requires undergoing underwriting again. Aditi asked for details on the underwriting process and required documents. The next steps involve the agent providing that information and guiding the customer through a potential new purchase.

action_items: Agent to provide details of the underwriting process and required documents
Customer to review information and decide on purchasing a new policy
